target.title: fix(agent): return data URIs for workspace-relative identity card avatars (#97602)
target.body: ## Summary `agent.identity.get` resolved workspace-relative agent avatars via `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl` to `/avatar/` route URLs. The Control UI Personal card renders those URLs in `` tags, which cannot carry Bearer auth headers — the images always show broken (401). This PR reads the validated local avatar file into a data URI inline in the response, so the browser can render it directly. Remote HTTP URLs, existing data URLs, and missing avatars are unchanged. The file-reading helper is a **private (non-exported) function** inside `agent.ts` — it does not appear on the public Plugin SDK surface. The workspace-root path is canonicalised with `realpathSync` to match the already-resolved `filePath` from `resolveAgentAvatar`, fixing containment checks for symlinked workspaces. Fixes #97602. ## What Problem This Solves The Personal card in Control UI shows a broken avatar image because `agent.identity.get` returns `/avatar/` (a path requiring Bearer auth), while `agents.list` correctly resolves workspace-relative avatars through the authenticated HTTP endpoint. `` tags cannot carry Authorization headers → always 401. Concretely, given a workspace with an avatar file `avatar.png`: - **Before**: `agent.identity.get` → avatar = `/avatar/main` (route URL → `` 401) - **After**: `agent.identity.get` → avatar = `data:image/png;base64,...` (inline data URI → `` renders correctly) ## Why This Change Was Made The fix is layered correctly: 1. **Private helper in `agent.ts`**: reads a validated local avatar file → data URI, using `realpathSync(workspaceDir)` for symlink-safe containment checks. Returns `null` on any failure (missing file, outside workspace, too large) — the caller falls back to the existing route URL. 2. **`agent.identity.get`**: when `resolveAgentAvatar` returns `kind: "local"`, converts the file to a data URI before passing it to `resolveAssistantAvatarUrl`. If conversion fails, the route URL is used as-is. 3. The helper is NOT exported — it stays inside the gateway module and does not leak onto the Plugin SDK surface via the `identity-avatar` re-export barrel. ## Changes - `src/gateway/server-methods/agent.ts`: added a private `readLocalAvatarDataUrl` function and call it from `agent.identity.get` when the avatar is a workspace-local file. - 1 file changed, +52/−3. ## User Impact Control UI Personal card avatars render consistently when the avatar source is a workspace-relative local file. Users no longer see broken images or 401s. Remote URLs, existing data URLs, text fallbacks, and the `/avatar/` HTTP endpoint are all unaffected. No public Plugin SDK surface is changed. ## Evidence - `identity-avatar.test.ts` (avatar resolution, workspace containment, public redaction): **26 passed, 2 test files** - `agent.test.ts` (agent.identity.get tests including redaction of unsafe avatar sources): **passing** (targeted run against identity-get and symlink-boundary tests) - `oxlint` on `agent.ts`: clean - CI: check-prod-types, check-lint, check-test-types passing ## AI-assisted This PR was AI-assisted (Claude Code). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) Co-Authored-By: Claude
